censoring_rule: Baseline and three-class rows are censored when the target window runs past the last bar or touches an unobserved bar. Next-nonzero rows are censored when no nonzero mid change is observed inside the cutoff window: the window runs past the last bar before any move, the window up to the first move touches an unobserved bar, or a complete observed window holds no move. A move observed before the last bar labels the row even when the cutoff window itself is incomplete. Censored rows are reported per track and per reason.
notes: Baseline is the preserved binary-sign task at each cell horizon; its features and labels are unchanged.
The nonzero track trains and scores only on rows where a move occurs within the cutoff, so its accuracy is conditional on a move occurring; the censored share is reported next to it.
Train class priors are train-only in every fold; the reported baseline in each cell is the training-majority predictor.
selection_rule: No test outcome is used for parameter selection. The default configuration stays the reported configuration regardless of results. Every grid cell is reported.
